newsitem.title: GERMANY: Hypo-Bank considers sale of Brau und Brunnen stake.
newsitem.headline: Hypo-Bank considers sale of Brau und Brunnen stake.

text.p: German Bayerische Hypotheken und Wechselbank AG, Hypo Bank, said on Wednesday that it was considering selling its stake in the German brewing and beverage group Brau und Brunnen.

Hypo Bank management board chairman Eberhard Martini told a news conference that the bank was in the "comfortable position" of holding 58 percent of the drinks group, which allowed them to offer a majority stake to interested investors as planned.
Hypo bought a controlling stake in Brau und Brunnen in December with a view to selling its stake on to other investors, but the move hit shares at the troubled brewery because of restructuring plans.
